text:
sarah (sales): Heads up team — Spectral (reseller) asked for a quick co-sell POC path. They want a 10-14 day run, EU host, SAML SSO, telemetry to their S3, and a very rough pricing comparison (hosted PAYG vs short dedicated commit). Also they submitted a security questionnaire with a few gating Qs.

maria (partner-eng): Summary from partner side: staging tenant, 2 admin users + 3 read-only test accounts, SAML (IdP metadata), telemetry push to partner S3, and an optional KMS link. They prefer eu-west region.

aj (solutions): Pricing rough ballpark (very preliminary): assume 150k tokens/day for 14 days -> ~2.1M tokens total. Hosted PAYG @ $0.00085/token -> ~$1.8k? wait math: 2.1M * 0.00085 = $1,785. Dedicated short-commit discount example -> ~30% off hosted -> ~$1,250 + small setup. (I'll run exact calc in spreadsheet). Note: cost varies a lot by model choice and quantization.

timo (infra): Regarding KMS/HSM: for POC we can accept a KMS ARN to encrypt telemetry keys (customer-managed CMK) across Dedicated/private. On-prem HSM or FIPS HSM requires infra lead time (3+ weeks). VPC peering also needs network owner approvals.

anna (legal): Security questionnaire highlights: 1) SOC2 Type II? Yes. 2) Pen test policy? We require an authorization and window; we can accept partner-supplied third-party reports if they include scope and findings. 3) Data residency? We can ensure eu-west hosting for tenant data in POC.

Spectral Rep (external): Thanks. Two quick asks: sample SAML metadata (entityID, ACS), and a simple checklist of what you need from us to stand up the tenant today. Also any quick note on traffic limits per minute?

maria (partner-eng): Checklist (one-pager):
- company domain (for IdP)
- IdP metadata XML or SAML endpoints (entityID, ACS URL)
- list of admin user emails (2) and test users (3)
- intended qps / tokens/day estimate
- telemetry S3 bucket ARN + cross-account role ARN OR signed presigned bucket policy
- KMS ARN if customer-managed keys
- preferred region (eu-west)
- legal contact for pen-test authorization

aj (solutions): Traffic guidance: for the POC we recommend capping concurrent requests to 25 and burst limit of 300 requests/min to avoid throttling. Example routing config (we use here for ops):

```json
{"routing": {"primary_model": "redwood-medium-8k", "fallback_model": "redwood-small-4k", "concurrency_limit": 25, "burst_per_min": 300}}
```

ops-bot: Provisioning: created staging tenant spec-spectral-cohort-07 (tenant_id: spc-07). SAML endpoint ready for metadata upload.

sarah (sales): Ops-bot 1 good. Spectral  can you upload IdP metadata to the tenant or paste the ACS/entityID here?

Spectral Rep (external): Uploading now. Also we've got a preview S3 bucket arn: arn:aws:s3:::spectral-preview-telemetry. Do you need a cross-account role?

timo (infra): Cross-account role is preferred. If they don't have one, we can accept a short-lived presigned put policy. For telemetry we need sample IAM policy; small example: 

```bash
aws iam create-role --role-name SpectralTelemetryAccess --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
# attach s3:PutObject to the target bucket prefix
```

anna (legal): I'll prepare the pen-test authorization template and SOC2 attestation pdf. Maria, please forward the partner's legal contact.

maria (partner-eng): Scheduled a 30m kickoff with Spectral tomorrow 11:00am CET (calendar invite sent). Legal ticket created: LEG-8202. Infra ticket INF-4648 for VPC/KMS actions. I'll attach the one-pager entitlement checklist to LEG-8202.

sarah (sales): Aj  can you produce that 1-slide pricing summary + spreadsheet by EOD? I want to present hosted vs short dedicated vs VPC-with-KMS scenario.

aj (solutions): On it. I'll include per-token assumptions, model SKU choices, and the impact of fallback routing on cost. Will post a link here.

Spectral Rep (external): Appreciate the fast turnaround. We'll bring domains and admin list to kickoff.

maria (partner-eng): Closing notes: leaving this thread open for entitlements + legal docs. Will update LEG-8202/INF-4648 when infra confirms cross-account role and SAML binding. If any immediate blocker appears, please @channel. :raised_hands:
